input.command: cd /tmp && rm -rf fdtest && mkdir fdtest && cd fdtest && for i in $(seq 1 200000); do echo x > "f$i"; done 2>/dev/null | head -1; ls | wc -l
cargo build 2>&1 | tail -10 && time ./target/debug/fd -IH . /tmp/fdtest -tf -X wc -l 2>&1 | tail -20
timeout 200 cargo test --test tests exec 2>&1 | tail -60
